title: Complete-machine execution on two tracks: engineering never waits for acceptance, and acceptance is never manufactured
statement: A small build is the next step. It is never a substitute for the destination.
exact_source_excerpt: VEPMC = 0 does not stop Track A.
changed_axis: sequence, immediate priority and evidence discipline (CLAUDE.md developmental-inheritance axes). The final intended effect, the completion boundary BODY + ORGANS + MIND and the authority envelope are unchanged.
intended_effect: Developmental engineering (Track A) advances continuously in controlled conditions and is never stopped by a missing device run, customer, payment or founder-only decision. Founder and external acceptance (Track B) keeps its own evidence and is never moved by a container, a test key, a synthetic founder or a rehearsal. Each increment is reproduced, fixed, verified, composed on one tree with its neighbours and handed to the integration owner; then the next unfinished dependency is recomputed and built.
executable_interpretation: Agents (1) start from a real defect or the highest-value buildable dependency, not a roadmap; the first named build is truthful recovery of a retained negative receipt, with the eight-step acceptance sequence in the source; (2) verify behaviour on a composed tree, since a clean merge proves nothing; (3) treat the eight proposed extensions (representation repair, evidence-dependency correction, proof-bearing plans, adaptive cognitive organization, transferable capability propagation, developmental-process improvement, goal opportunity synthesis, functional reconstitution) as bounded experiments with the minimum tests the source gives, extending canonical owners and inspecting existing mechanisms first; (4) report in the founder's language, leading with what GREG can reliably do now that it could not do before; (5) leave an exact continuation package when a resource limit forces a pause. Revoking a device invalidates its unused authority at once while completed actions stay in the ledger; a suspected compromise opens a separate retrospective review. No probability estimates or process-quality scores stand in for engineering results. The directive's own disposition for the proposed extensions is EXPERIMENT.
owner: Alfonso Lopez (founder authority); the integration owner and implementing sessions on board #96
binding_scope: Work selection, sequencing, verification and reporting on the integration line (#196 and its children) and in the participating organ repositories. Reversible implementation, tests and draft review only. No merge of a protected or default branch, deployment, spending, publishing, outside contact, live-credential change or activation of a consequential capability.
constitutional_constraints: Chat text is intent evidence, not founder authentication; it authorizes no runtime act
The approximately six-month founder-guided developmental framework remains binding; time, tests, architecture or model confidence do not authorize graduation
VEPMC and commercial evidence stay authentic: a container, test key, synthetic founder or rehearsal moves neither
Constitutional authority stays fixed while operational competence grows; protected authority rules change only through the existing authenticated founder-approval process
No second authority office and no new framework to repair a boundary the Kernel owns
Retirement decisions are preserved; a historical venture, including IVIO-NEMT, is not reactivated by mention
Requalification never restores revoked execution permission
success_evidence: Draft pull requests into the integration line, each with fail-before and pass-after evidence, adverse cases, a composed-tree run and a mutation gate, while VEPMC stays 0
tests/unit/test_founder_directive_20261111.py: the three messages are kept whole with matching digests, the pinned sentences are in them, and the record has every required ledger field
failure_evidence: A report that names a missing device run, customer, payment or signature as the reason engineering stopped
A container run, test key or rehearsal reported as founder-used, live, externally verified or commercially validated
A read-only audit or a new architecture document presented as the directive executed
An unfinished buildable requirement relabelled as an external blocker, or a test threshold lowered after a failure
dependencies: INTENT-20261030-BUILD-BEFORE-DEVICE-RUN (the sequencing correction this restates and widens)
conflicts: The N1 to N7 path in greg/path.json orders founder and commercial acceptance. Resolved by the source: that path is kept for Track B evidence and does not sequence Track A; "N7 unachieved does not stop Track A".

The source's sixteenth section rejects several guarantees found in earlier project texts (a content hash as truth, a revert as undoing an external effect, consensus as verification). The earlier texts are kept as lineage; where they conflict, the later statement governs.

Message C contains a preparation appendix written while drafting it. It is kept verbatim as part of what the founder sent; its claims about what was inspected are that draft's own and are not repository evidence.
next_review_trigger: The founder corrects or replaces this directive, declares the prompt completely built, or runs the device acceptance
supersedes: Any reading in which VEPMC, N7, a paid customer or a missing founder decision is a prerequisite for continuing engineering (sequencing only; each measure is kept)
